items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I think, Marshall or something like that, that had another big nightclub--that had another big restaurant in Los Angeles

ctx.x: Which was right over the L.A. City line into L.A. County.

In the county, but you couldn't buy it in Los Angeles. So there was another big white fellow named...uh, I think, Marshall or something like that, that had another big nightclub--that had another big restaurant in Los Angeles, and he opened a place in Watts. And there was three or four big white places in Watts. But Baron Long had the place called the Baron Long Taverns, which he took over from Al Levy. Al Levy, before that, built the Tavern, which had a big restaurant in Los Angeles on Third and Main Street,…
Which you said was at the beach. Right?
